title: Laura Cress Reveals Her Top Picks from This Year's Gamescom
seoTitle: Laura Cress: Gamescom's Hottest Reveals & Highlights
subtitle: With six editions under her belt, the BBC reporter offers an exclusive look at Cologne's latest game releases.
excerpt: BBC's Laura Cress returns to Gamescom for her sixth visit, offering a first-hand look at major titles, from *Witcher 3* to *Alien: Isolation 2*.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
BBC reporter Laura Cress arrives for her sixth Gamescom, sharing what excites her most this year. Her report provides an overview of the biggest games presented in Cologne, offering an initial glimpse into titles poised to make their mark on the industry.

First Look at the Highlights

Among the standout attractions, Cress's coverage includes the classic Witcher 3, which is once again gaining prominence at the expo, and the highly anticipated Alien: Isolation 2, also holding a significant presence at the event.

Cress's continuous presence at Gamescom allows her to offer a unique perspective, comparing this year's new releases with experiences from previous editions. Her keen eye highlights how the games presented reflect current market trends and expectations.

With information from BBC News.
